claims.evidence: Witness report shows a used diesel/industrial engine assembly with no readable brand/model markings; no make/model plate details were captured.

risks.risk: Wrong engine identity (model/make not confirmed); pricing depends heavily on exact model and configuration.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the engine nameplate/serial plate (make, model, displacement) and any stamped markings on the block.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unidentified used industrial diesel engine (worst-case) with no confirmed marine configuration.

risks.risk: Not running / unknown mechanical condition (compression, starting, smoke, power output).
risks.proof: Video clip of a cold start (or start attempt) showing cranking, ignition, stable idle, and smoke level; include a brief run under load if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-tested/possibly not working (worst-case) and treat as parts/repair.

risks.risk: Major wear or internal faults (cylinder head/crank/bearings) not visible from exterior.
risks.proof: Compression test results (all cylinders) and/or a borescope/inspection report; also show any service records if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming unknown wear and potential overhaul needed.

risks.risk: Leaks and seal/gasket condition (oil/coolant/fuel) not confirmed in the report.
risks.proof: Photos and short clips showing the engine underside and around joints after wiping clean (oil/coolant/fuel seepage).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming possible leaks and needing reseal/maintenance.

risks.risk: Missing or incomplete accessories (starter, alternator, turbo, injectors, cooling/radiator parts) affecting usability and value.
risks.proof: Inventory checklist with photos of all included components; specifically confirm starter, alternator, turbo (if any), injectors, fuel system parts, and cooling components.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst-case) and deduct for missing cooling/starting/fuel accessories.

risks.risk: Cooling system/radiator and marine-specific integration not shown; may require additional parts to be operational.
risks.proof: Photos of the full unit as assembled (engine + cooling + mounting + any marine gearbox/controls if present).
risks.if_unproven: Price as engine-only/partial assembly with additional parts likely required.

risks.risk: Transport/mounting readiness (how it will be removed/installed; mounting points and condition).
risks.proof: Photos showing mounting feet/brackets, lifting points, and how it is currently secured; include a clip of lifting/handling readiness.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming extra labor/rigging and possible mounting repairs.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the engine nameplate/serial plate showing make/model (and serial number).
Video of the engine starting (cold start if possible) with stable running and smoke level.
Compression test results (or equivalent mechanical test) for all cylinders.
Photos after wiping the engine clean to check for active oil/coolant/fuel leaks (underside and around seals).
Full inventory photos of included accessories (starter, alternator, turbo if any, injectors, fuel system parts, cooling/radiator parts).
Photos of the complete unit (not just the engine) showing mounting/gearbox/controls if it is truly marine-ready.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a used diesel/industrial engine assembly, but the specific claim (Detriot 671 marine engine) and running/mechanical condition are not verifiable from the provided report. Without a nameplate and a start/run proof, a worst-case price would be too speculative.
